subject.title: fix(guarded-mkdir): allow in-root symlinked directory components

question: Should helper-enabled modes adopt the same containment-checked support for in-root symlinked directory parents as the Node fallback, or should fallback-only support be an intentional documented contract?
rationale: The patch alters a filesystem containment boundary in only one runtime mode, and the durable contract cannot be safely inferred from tests of the fallback alone.

options.title: Require cross-mode parity
options.body: Keep the PR open until helper and fallback modes enforce the same containment-preserving symlink-parent behavior.

options.title: Approve a documented mode split
options.body: Accept helper-enabled rejection as intentional only with explicit maintainer approval and documentation of the configuration-dependent behavior.

recommendation.title: Require cross-mode parity
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until helper and fallback modes enforce the same containment-preserving symlink-parent behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion specifically routes the helper/fallback contract question to this person.
